name: counted-source-gate
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; trap 'find "$OUT" -maxdepth 3 -type d -name .lake -exec rm -rf {} +' EXIT; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bunx tsc -p research/bapa/tsconfig.counted-source.json > "$OUT/types.log" 2>&1; BAPA_COUNTED_SOURCE_TINY="$OUT/tiny" bun test research/bapa/counted-source-data.test.ts research/bapa/proof-counted-source.test.ts research/bapa/proof-source-verify.test.ts > "$OUT/tests.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/tiny"; lake build > "$OUT/tiny-lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean >> "$OUT/tiny-lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$OUT/tiny-lean.log" BapaProof.lean > "$OUT/tiny-axioms.log" 2>&1; cd "$ROOT"; for item in simple_election:7654c0e364334f0835602b06dcfc7307fdc089d0825f92d17e16f5a67a84ff75 toy_consensus:4558a6d95c1f2462f58baffa3dd094bbe8023f6ee4f6b132f47b65b41bc44a84 quorum_leader_election:26190ed5247317ec80f418e9218cbce744daf79cff12ce139b67326c0f0f9c32; do id=${item%%:*}; sha=${item#*:}; CASE="$OUT/$id"; mkdir "$CASE"; bun research/bapa/proof-counted-source.ts --capture "counted-$id" --sha256 "$sha" --out "$CASE/project" > "$CASE/emission.log" 2>&1; cp -a "$OUT/tiny/.lake" "$CASE/project/.lake"; cd "$CASE/project"; lake build > "$CASE/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean >> "$CASE/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/research/bapa/proof-source-verify.ts" "$CASE/project" "$CASE/lean.log" "$CASE/SOURCE-CHECKED.json" > "$CASE/source-check.log" 2>&1; cd "$ROOT"; done; printf '%s\n' 'feat(bapa): check counted-family source correspondence' > "$OUT/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$OUT/commit-message.txt" > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1
